chapter.verse: Tua nung ciangin ciangkhut tawh kibang pumpeeng khat kei hong piak khit ciangin, “Tho in la, Pasian’ biakinnpi ahi zongin, biakna tau ahi zongin, biakinnpi sungah a bia mite ahi zongin teh in.

Biakinnpi pua lamah a om gawl sung teh kei in, siit in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tua gawl sung mun Gentailte ading a kipia zo hi. Amaute in Khuapi Siangtho zong kha sawmli leh kha nih tawntung a sik gawp ding uh hi.
Ka teci nihte zong thu ka pia ding a, amaute in khautang puan silhin ni tul khat, zanih leh sawmguk dongin kamsangte bangin thu a hilh ding uh hi,” hong ci hi.
Tua mite in leitung Topa mai-ah a om oliv kung nih, meivak koihna nih ahi uh hi.
Mi khatpeuh mah in amaute tungah gimna a bawl nop leh, amaute kam sungpan mei pusuakin a galte a kangtum thei hi. Mi khatpeuh in tua bang gimna a bawl nop leh, tua bangin thahna a thuak ding hi.

Tua mite nih in kamsangin a om uh hun lai takin guahzuk loh nadingin vantung khak theihna vangliatna a ngah uh tham loin, tui, sisan a suahsak theih nading ahi zongin, a deih peuhpeuh ciangin leitung pulnatna pawl khempeuh tawh a daantat theih nading thu a nei uh hi.
Amaute in a teci pan’na a zawh khit uh ciangin kuam thukpi sung pan hong kahto sahang in amau doin zoin a that ding hi.
Amaute luangte zong a Topa uh singlamteh tungah a sihna khuapi ahi, a khiatna in Sodom leh Izipt a kici khuapi sungah a om lampi tungah a om uh a,
mipawl, minam, kam, gamte sungpan mite in tua a luangte vuisak loin nithum leh nilang tawntung a en ding uh hi.
Leitungah a om mite in zong tua kamsang nihte in a bawlsia ngei ahih manin, tua a luangte hangin lungdamin khat leh khat nuamna nate a kipia ding uh hi.
Nithum leh nilang a cin’ khit ciangin tua mite sungah Pasian kiang pan nuntakna huih lutin amaute in a thawh uh, a din’ uh ciangin a en mite khempeuh a lau mahmah ding uh hi.
Vantung panin zong, “Hih lai takah hong kahto un,” ci-in nakpi-in thupiakna aw a za uh a, vantung meii tungah tuangin a kahto uh amaute galte in a mu uh hi.
Tua hun lai takin zin nakpi liingin khuapi seh sawm suah seh khat cimin, mi tulsagih a si uh hi. A om lai mite lau-in liingin, vantung Pasian’ vangliatna a phat uh hi.
Nihna gimna a bei zo hi. En in, thumna gimna a manlangin hong tung ding hi.
Sagihna vantungmi in peengkul a tum ciangin, “Hih leitung gam in i Topa leh ama Khazih gam a suak zo hi. Amah in a tawntungin a uk ding hi,” ci-in vantungah nakpi-in a genna aw ka za hi.
Tua lai takin Pasian mai-ah amau tokhom tungah a tu uh upa sawmnih leh lite in bokin Pasian bia-in:
“Tu lai takin a om, a om ngeizo, Vanglianpen Topa Pasian aw, nang in a lian bel vangliatna la-in na uk ciangin na hehpihna ka phat uh hi.

Mipawl khempeuh a heh uh a, na hehna ahi zongin, a si mite thukhen nading hun ahi zongin, na sila kamsangte-a kipan misiangthote leh, na min a kihta milian leh mineu lungdamna na piak nading hun ahi zongin, leitung a siasak mite a siatsak nading ahi zongin a tung zo hi,” ci-in a gen uh hi.
Vantungah a om Pasian’ biakinnpi kihongin thuciamna singkuang biakinnpi sungah a kimuh khit ciangin khuaphelepte, kam aw gingte, vangingte, zinliingte, nakpi gialkiatnate a piang uh hi.
